shell_commands: cd target && node -e "import Ajv from 'ajv'; console.log(typeof Ajv); console.log(Ajv)"

cd target && echo "import Ajv from 'ajv'; import type {Options} from 'ajv'; const o: Options = {strict: false}; const a = new (Ajv as any)(o);" > test-ajv.ts && npx tsc test-ajv.ts --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && rm test-ajv.ts test-ajv.js

cd target && echo "import Ajv from 'ajv'; import type {Options} from 'ajv'; const o: Options = {strict: false}; const a = new Ajv(o);" > test-ajv.ts && npx tsc test-ajv.ts --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && rm test-ajv.ts test-ajv.js
rm target/test-ajv.ts && cd target && npm run eslint
cd target && npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md

cd target && git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "fix(tools): address Ajv ESM compatibility and fix spec links" && git push origin HEAD
cd target && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD
